description: There exists a CONTRADICTS relationship with the strict signal profile: same resolved entity, predicate_similarity >= predicate_similarity_threshold (or exact), unit_equivalent, period_relation in (equal, overlaps), no scope_conflict, both modality in (HISTORICAL, ASSERTED), base_value_delta_pct > numeric_contradiction_threshold, deterministic validation did not demote it, and reasoning is present. If a corpus has no face-value contradiction, set must_hold false and record it (EVALUATION_PLAN section 4).
